name: ASUS router (AiMesh)
description: Reads which device is connected to which AiMesh node (stock ASUSWRT, tested on an RT-AX92U) so the hierarchy and the map show every client's real network position. Read-only: one login, two reads and a logout per sync, never SSH, so no sessions are left open on the router. A refused login pauses automatic syncing so the router does not lock the account.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: Reads the router's Traffic Analyzer when it is on: bytes per application and per device for today and yesterday, shown in Statistics > Applications (needs Netlens 0.4.154 or newer). New setting Read the Traffic Analyzer statistics (on by default); models without the Traffic Analyzer pages are skipped. Nothing else changed.
Now an ordinary plugin (it was built into Netlens before 0.4.44). Same code as the built-in version 1.1.0; Netlens installs it again by itself for existing setups.
